text:
On one's back, or beneath the lamp
run to Fuji's foot and look upward
at the snowy peak, the snow boots
wet and cold, the wilted collar.
How, I ask, to investigate distance
with one's own feet, how, I ask, to experience distance
with one's own eyes. How to join longing for distance
with staying still. How, feet and eyes,
tears and pleasure.

translation.title: Better to Travel in Thought, Hokusai
